Inform's own copy of the onadata API reference (27 API pages); mechanical inventory identical to onaio/onadata main docs/*.rst

notes: UNICEF Inform (data.inform.unicef.org) runs Ona's open-source onadata server and hosts onadata's own Sphinx API reference; there is no machine spec anywhere (checked the instance, api.ona.io, the onadata repo, apis.guru, SwaggerHub, Postman). This spec is authored from that reference: a mechanical inventory of every documented method+path across all 27 API pages (prettyprint blocks plus curl examples) was built first and every row maps to an operation (194 operations, 132 paths, 69 schemas), replacing a 6-operation stub. Paths keep their /api/v1, /api/v2 prefixes because OpenRosa (/formList, /{username}/{pk}/submission) and OAuth (/o/token/) routes live at the root. Schemas come from the docs' example responses; submissions and dataview/merged-dataset records are open objects since their keys are form fields. Docs quirks kept as notes on the operations: POST vs GET /formList, POST vs DELETE delete_async, /project/ vs /projects/ labels, /profile/ vs /profiles/ change_password, PUT invitations with or without an id. All six adaptor operations map: GET /api/v1/forms, /forms/{pk}, /forms/{pk}/form.{format} (structureOnly), /data/{pk}, /data/{pk}/{dataid}, /media/{pk}, and /files/{pk} for downloadAttachment, which the old stub lacked. Not modelled: router-only, undocumented viewsets (briefcase, osm, private-data, totp, v1 open-data); Flow Results package detail and responses routes come from the FLOIP specification the docs defer to, confirmed in onadata's floip_viewset. GET /api/v1/files/{pk} now documents its 302 + Location response (2026-11-14): onadata's media view redirects to storage, and the adaptor's downloadAttachment reads that Location header; only 200 was declared before.
